App details

Work Manager

Organize clients, jobs, deadlines and costs, with a clear view of the next task.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Keep client jobs and their next steps together on your device. Track tasks, deadlines, materials, recorded costs and working time, then prepare a PDF work sheet. Voice entry helps capture a new job while you work and asks you to confirm the details.

Main features

  • Job status, tasks and reminders.
  • Materials, recorded costs and working time.
  • Capture a new job by voice, then confirm it.
  • Create readable PDF work sheets.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Organise a job from intake to completion

Jobs, customers, tasks and status

Create a job with a required title and optional customer, address, notes, priority and deadline. Split it into ordered checkable tasks. Set New, Planned, In progress, Waiting, Completed or Archived; completing a task does not complete the whole job automatically. Reopen finished work while retaining history; one customer can have several jobs.

Today, calendar, reminders and recurring jobs

Browse Today, Tomorrow, This week and Overdue, or a week/month calendar. Opt into reminders with chosen advance time. Create a reusable task/material/note template or weekly/monthly/yearly recurrence; each new job is separate and earlier jobs stay unchanged. Search customers/jobs/notes and filter status, deadline, priority or customer; dashboard counts open matching lists.

Materials, expenses, estimates and work time

Enter a checkable material list with quantity/unit and optional unit price for estimated material cost. Record travel, parking, subcontractor or other costs and optional quote/revenue; remaining amount is an estimate, not accounting profit. Different currencies are not automatically summed. Start/stop one job timer or add/edit time manually; starting another warns about the active timer.

Capture a new job by voice, then confirm

Start microphone capture and dictate the new job’s date/time, place/address and description. Review the transcript and suggested fields, correct uncertainty and confirm before creating the job. The phone’s speech service may need internet; manual entry always works without it. There is no background listening or unconfirmed job creation.

Customer numbers and system calling

Enter a number manually or choose a customer/contact, including a number not saved as a contact. Open the system phone or email action deliberately. Any last-call number suggestion depends on permitted call-data access; manual number entry and voice capture remain usable without call history. Contact access is separate from the basic job workflow.

Photos, documents, PDF sheet and offline backup

Attach before/during/after photos or selected documents to a job. Export a readable job summary or PDF work sheet with customer/job, tasks, materials, time, costs and notes; it is not an invoice. Back up jobs, customers, templates and related records offline, then preview/validate before restoring. Attachment references may need their separately saved physical files; nothing uploads automatically.

Done, then back in progress

Tap the About logo seven times: a drawn worker checks Done, puts tools away, then hears something fall and the job becomes In progress again. This offline scene changes no real job, deadline or saved record.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
